index.description: The index in the node array. May be **different than** material, geometry and attribute `resource` id. See [`mesh`](mesh.cmn.md) for more information.

parentIndex.description: The index of the parent node in the node array.

lodThreshold.description: When to switch LoD. See [`nodepages[i].lodSelectionMetricType`](nodePageDefinition.cmn.md) for more information.

obb.description: Oriented bounding box for this node.

children.description: index of the children nodes indices.

mesh.description: The mesh for this node. **WARNING:** only **SINGLE** mesh is supported at version 1.7 (i.e. `length` **must** be 0 or 1).
